Forward local ports to ports on a box through the orchestrator, until Ctrl-C.

Usage: termag forward <box> <port>[:<local>]…

Each <port> on the box is reached at localhost:<local> (default: the same port) on
127.0.0.1 and ::1 only. Local ports start at 1024.
  termag forward devbox 3000 5173
  termag forward devbox 80:8080

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
